title: GOV.UK Page Template
description: Official page chrome in canonical DOM order: skip link, header, breadcrumbs, content, footer.

components.reason: First focusable element; targets the main content region
GOV.UK header with logotype and service name
Below header for pages deeper than two levels
Support links and licence notice; last element in body

nesting: Canonical DOM order 1 → 2 → 3 → <main id='main-content'>…</main> → 4. Skip-link targets the main region
validationOrder: Breadcrumbs' last item carries aria-current='page' and is not a link
One h1 per page inside main
a11yNotes: Header is the banner landmark, footer the contentinfo landmark
agentPromptSequence: 1. Place the skip link as the first element in body
2. Add the header, then breadcrumbs if the page is deep
